figurative_meaning_en: A vast expanse or foundation comparable to the ocean
example_sentences_in_english: His knowledge is as vast as an ocean.
The poem is an ocean of rasa.
history: References the classical Sanskrit work Meghdoot by Kalidasa, described as an 'ocean of rasa' (aesthetic essence) in literary criticism, influencing Bengali poetic traditions.
note: Commonly used in compound forms like 'রসের সাগর' to denote profound depth in arts and emotions.
